summary: SiteDocument represents a document attached or related to a 'Site' entity. It comprises ID and SiteID fields for referencing. No business logic, workflow, or user interaction is provided beyond basic data structure.
purpose: To model document relationships for a Site, likely enabling attachment, display, or tracking of documents associated with a Site.

fields.name: SiteID
fields.description: Identifier for the Site the document is associated with.

content_gaps: No information on workflows, business rules, user interaction, or document metadata beyond IDs.

summary: WelcomeStaffAdmin provides a staff admin dashboard for viewing employment applications filtered by site, discipline, and date range, including withdrawn applications. It displays last login info and error or warning panels. Data is presented on a grid with paging, sorting, and detail links.
purpose: To serve as a welcome and oversight screen for staff administrators, showing application data, status (submitted/withdrawn), and supporting navigation, error/warning display, and date filtering.

fields.name: StartDate
fields.description: Filter start date for application search.

fields.name: EndDate
fields.description: Filter end date for application search.

workflows.name: View Employment Applications
steps: Select site and discipline from dropdowns.
Choose date range using start/end date fields and calendar extenders.
Click refresh to update grid data.
Grid displays submitted and withdrawn employment applications with detail links.
Email links are provided if applicant has an email.
Error and warning panels display system messages.

business_rules: Applications are filtered by site, discipline, and date.
Withdrawn applications are shown if checkbox is enabled.
StartDate must be before or equal to EndDate.
Validation is enforced on date fields.
conditions: Show withdrawn applications if checkbox is checked.
Display error and warning panels if messages exist.
system_behavior: Grid auto-generates columns, supports paging and sorting.
Data binding updates the employment application list.
Error and warning panels can be hidden by user.
dependencies: User session determines agency and last login info.
content_gaps: No detailed information about how applications are processed after viewing.
No explicit audit or permission logic described.

summary: ServiceCode is a data model for codes used to classify services. It supports multiple languages, categorization, ordering, and notes. Retrieval functions provide lists by course or timetable.
purpose: To categorize and provide metadata for services, supporting filtering and multilingual display.

fields.name: ID
fields.description: Unique identifier for the service code.

fields.name: Name
fields.description: Description (primary language or alternate if configured).

workflows.name: Retrieve Service Codes
steps: Call ServiceCodeListAll to retrieve all codes for session.
Call ServiceCodeASMOptionByCourseID to retrieve options for a course.
Call ServiceCodeASMOptionByTimetableID to retrieve options for a timetable.
Localize codes to alt language if session is configured.

business_rules: If UseAltLanguageFields is true, use alternate language fields for Name and Notes.
system_behavior: Retrieval methods return lists based on parameters (session, course, timetable).
Localization logic switches displayed text depending on session language setting.
dependencies: Depends on session language setting for localization.
content_gaps: No information on user interaction, editing, or validation beyond field structure and retrieval.

summary: SiteProfileHistory models a change log of site profiles, recording action date, section, user, and agency details. Supports detailed formatted output and localization based on session language.
purpose: To track history and audit changes made to site profiles by users, storing user and agency metadata and formatting details for display or tooltip.

fields.name: ByOriginalUserID
fields.description: Original user if acting as another.

fields.name: ByUserSysAdmin
fields.description: Whether action was by a SysAdmin.

workflows.name: Search SiteProfileHistory
steps: Call SiteProfileHistorySearch with SiteID and SessionAgencyID.
Display formatted change history with user and agency details.

business_rules: If UseAltLanguageFields is true, ScreenSection, UserAction, and Fields are localized.
Display of user details varies depending on whether SysAdmin or acting as another user.
conditions: UserSession must be set for search.
system_behavior: History list generated for site profile changes.
Tooltip/details string formatted for user display.
dependencies: Depends on NameFormatter, Resources, DateFormatter, Phone, UserSession.
content_gaps: Field-level audit details are inferred but not shown.
No information on who can view/audit this history.

summary: EmailPopupDocument and EmailPopupDocuments model files associated with email popups, including file name, path, and checked state. Provides functionality to search, delete, and manage document files.
purpose: To enable file attachment, display, selection, and deletion within email popup contexts.

fields.name: Checked
fields.description: Indicates if the file is selected.

workflows.name: Manage Email Popup Files
steps: Search files by parsing DataInfo string.
Delete file by ID: find file path and folder, delete file and folder.

business_rules: Files are managed in DataInfo strings (delimited, paired with paths).
Deletion attempts to remove file and enclosing folder, with error suppression.
conditions: Only DataInfo strings with valid delimiters processed.
system_behavior: Search returns list of file objects from DataInfo string.
Delete removes file/folder and updates list.
dependencies: Depends on file system and DataInfo string format.
content_gaps: No information about UI interaction or security for file operations.
